issue_context.title: Svelte 5: snippets with multiple default values get incorrectly parsed
issue_context.body: ### Describe the bug If there's a snippet with multiple default values the parse incorrectly assume everything after the last = is the right argument of the assignment. Eg. ```svelte {#snippet test(a,b=3,c=2)} {/snippet} ``` is compiled to ```ts var test = ($$anchor, a = $.noop, $$arg1) => { let b = $.derived_safe_equal(() => $.value_or_fallback($$arg1?.(), () => (3, c = 2))); }; ``` that causes a runtime error since c is not defined. You can also check the AST produced to see that the assignment right expression has an assignment expression itself ### Reproduction 1. go to [this repl](https://svelte-5-preview.vercel.app/#H4sIAAAAAAAAEy3JywqDQAxG4VcpfzcKgYLdDbjoc3S68BJhQGMwUZBh3l2ELs93MqY0syF8M6RbGAEfVRD81Dvs4NkZBFv3bbglP02SKvvD2bzqqG_fNLRNXaJEya__LVFAWNYxTYlHBN92Lr9yAYrxSrNwAAAA) 2. check the compiled code ### Logs _No response_ ### System Info ```shell repl ``` ### Severity annoyance
